title: Walt's Original Magic Kingdom
intro: [excited] Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight we are heading WEST to Anaheim... the place where it all began, the Disneyland Resort. Grab your ears and a churro, [chuckles] because Walt's original park is the star of the show.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a pink-and-blue fairytale castle at golden hour seen down a gaslit Victorian main street, a red horse-drawn streetcar, orange groves on the horizon, balloons and bunting, 1950s California charm

categories.title: Yo Ho, Yo Ho
categories.intro: [mischievously] Our film category sails straight out of a Disneyland ride. It's Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl. Savvy?

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a black-sailed pirate galleon under a full moon on a misty Caribbean sea, a treasure chest of glowing gold coins on a cave shore

clues.clue: Johnny Depp's swaggering pirate in The Curse of the Black Pearl insists you add the title Captain to his name. Who is he?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain Jack Sparrow. [laughs] Captain! Never forget the Captain, or he will give you that look.

clues.clue: What is the name of the fast ship with black sails that Jack Sparrow wants back?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Black Pearl. It's right there in the title, folks. [chuckles] Free points for paying attention.

clues.clue: Barbossa's cursed crew are revealed as walking skeletons whenever they step into what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is moonlight. [chuckles] Great news for their tanning budget, terrible news for their dating lives.

clues.clue: Barbossa's cursed pet monkey shares his name with which other pirate?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Jack. [mischievously] Barbossa named his monkey after his old captain, which is the pettiest thing a pirate has ever done.

clues.clue: The cursed Aztec gold is stashed on which island that can only be found by those who already know where it is?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is... Isla de Muerta, the Island of the Dead. Not a great spot for a beach vacation.

categories.title: Walt's Happy Place
categories.intro: Time for a little history class. [chuckles] Don't worry, there's no homework. These clues are all about Disneyland's past, from opening day to Walt's secret hideaways.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a vintage 1955 opening-day scene: a hand-painted map of a theme park, a glowing lamp in a firehouse window, sepia tones mixed with bright colors

clues.clue: Disneyland is located in which California city?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Anaheim. [laughs] Walt bought orange groves there, so technically the happiest place on Earth used to be a juice farm.

clues.clue: In what year did Disneyland first open its gates?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1955. July 17th, to be exact. Happy birthday, Disneyland!

clues.clue: Walt Disney had a private apartment hidden above which Main Street building?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Fire Station. A lamp still glows in the window to show Walt is always with us. [sniffles] I'm not crying, you're crying.

clues.clue: Opening day in 1955 was so chaotic, with melted asphalt and broken water fountains, that employees nicknamed it what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Black Sunday. High heels got stuck in the fresh asphalt. Rough first day at the office.

clues.clue: Which Disneyland attraction, opened in 1959, was the world's first tubular steel roller coaster?
clues.reveal: Drumroll, please... the correct answer is the Matterhorn Bobsleds. [chuckles] Every steel coaster you love owes a thank you to this mountain.

categories.title: Across the Esplanade
categories.intro: Let's walk across the plaza to Disneyland's sister park, Disney California Adventure. [excited] It's a PICTURE category, so feast your eyes!

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a sunlit California seaside pier with a big wheel and a looping coaster, red-rock desert mountains shaped like car tail fins in the distance

clues.clue: Which Disney California Adventure land brings Radiator Springs to life?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cars Land. [mischievously] Ka-chow! The Cadillac Range glows at sunset and it is gorgeous.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

clues.clue: Which Cars Land attraction races guests side by side through Ornament Valley?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Radiator Springs Racers. [whispers] Pro tip, the winning car is random, so stop leaning forward. It doesn't help.

clues.clue: Grizzly River Run splashes riders at the base of a mountain shaped like which animal?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a grizzly bear. The land is LITERALLY called Grizzly Peak. [sarcastic] Did the bear give it away?

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a rocky mountain peak carved by nature into the shape of a roaring bear's head above a whitewater river with round rafts

clues.clue: Before it became the Incredicoaster in 2018, Pixar Pier's big coaster went by what name?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is California Screamin'. Now the Incredibles chase baby Jack-Jack around the track instead.

clues.clue: In what year did Disney California Adventure open next door to Disneyland?
clues.reveal: [gasps] Oh, this one is TOUGH. The correct answer is... 2001. [laughs] It has had a big glow-up since then. We don't talk about the early years.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a bright California-themed theme-park entrance plaza with a golden bridge sculpture and blue sky, dated postcard feel

categories.title: Emoji-Land
categories.intro: Name the Disneyland attraction from the emoji. I'll throw in a hint... [sarcastic] because I am SUCH a generous host.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: giant glossy cartoon emoji-style bubbles floating over a fantasy theme-park skyline: an elephant ear, a ghost, a tropical flower, a little green car, a world globe

clues.clue: 🐘👂✈️  Name this Fantasyland attraction. Hint: an elephant who learned to fly.
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Dumbo the Flying Elephant. Big ears, big smiles, and a VERY long line for a ninety second spin.

clues.clue: 🌍👧🎶⛵  Name this boat ride. Hint: the happiest cruise that ever sailed.
accept: it's a small world after all
clues.reveal: The correct answer is it's a small world. And now that song is stuck in your head for the rest of the night. [laughs] You're welcome.

clues.clue: 👻🏚️🕰️  Name this New Orleans Square attraction. Hint: 999 happy haunts.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion. [mischievously] There's always room for one more, so hurry back.

clues.clue: 🦜🌺🗿🎶  Name this Adventureland show from 1963. Hint: the birds sing words and the flowers croon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room, the first attraction to use Audio-Animatronics. Those birds were pioneers.

clues.clue: 🐸🚗💨🔥  Name this opening-day Fantasyland dark ride. Hint: a reckless amphibian behind the wheel.
clues.reveal: [whispers] Only the true Disney nerds got this one. The correct answer is... Mr. Toad's Wild Ride. [laughs] It's been running since 1955 and the ending still goes somewhere very warm.

categories.title: Disneyland Deep Cuts
categories.intro: [whispers] The Club DJ crowd asked for Disneyland secrets... so let's dig into the stuff only the superfans know.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a hidden ornate door with brass fixtures in a New Orleans-style courtyard at night, a sleepy cat on a bench, lantern light

clues.clue: Which castle stands at the heart of Disneyland park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty Castle. It's smaller than Cinderella's castle in Florida, but it's the original, baby.

clues.clue: A colony of cats roams Disneyland at night, helping keep the park free of which pests?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is mice. [laughs] The irony of cats patrolling Mickey's house is not lost on me.

clues.clue: Disneyland's ultra-exclusive private dining club, Club 33, is tucked away in which land?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New Orleans Square. Look for the little 33 by the door. No, you can't just walk in. [sighs] I tried.

clues.clue: Sleeping Beauty Castle's design was inspired by which real castle in Bavaria, Germany?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Neuschwanstein Castle. King Ludwig the Second built it in the 1800s, and Walt borrowed the vibe.

clues.clue: The castle drawbridge has only been lowered twice: on opening day in 1955 and in what year, when a new Fantasyland debuted?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] And the correct answer is... 1983, when the New Fantasyland opened. [mischievously] If you saw it, you are an elite Disney nerd and I salute you.
